latestVersion.changelog: Adaptive onboard day planner for life at sea. Builds practical 24h routines by vessel type, role, timezone, watch model (4/4, 3/3, 6/6, solo), and internet limits. Prioritizes sleep protection, safety handovers, recurring safety scans, and offline-first productivity for low-bandwidth conditions.
